answer: Require every agent to lock a $100 bond in escrow for 90 days before it earns weight. A proven duplicate or fraud report slashes that bond, so the money only comes back to a clean identity. The bond works as a bridge between a free key and a real claim, since anyone can mint keys but few will park cash behind each one. Picture a jetty where each boat pays harbour dues before it docks, and the kernel rule stays plain: no bond, no weight. An attacker chasing 1,000 fake agents must lock $100,000 up front and risk losing it, while one honest operator locks $100 once.
